## Features

Every feature is in `features.ts`: 1 features (1 building).

- Before adding UI, routes or flags, run `genesis features find <term>` to see whether a feature already covers it.
- New work starts as an entry in `features.ts`; then run `genesis features build`. `genesis features check` runs in CI.
- Finding, adding and retiring features: `.claude/skills/features/SKILL.md`.

Generated by `genesis features build`. Don't edit this block.
